messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "510", "observation": "The recording features footsteps on a hard surface, rustling fabric, and a sharp tearing sound, likely from opening a package."}, {"id": "525", "observation": "A person breathes heavily, then a loud, high-pitched scream is heard."}, {"id": "540", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact is followed by a deep, resonant roar and a series of heavy, rhythmic thuds."}, {"id": "555", "observation": "A woman speaks, followed by a loud explosion, metallic clanking, and a deep, resonant roar."}, {"id": "570", "observation": "A loud, high-pitched scream is followed by a deep, resonant roar and a series of metallic clanks and scrapes."}, {"id": "585", "observation": "A person breathes heavily, followed by a loud, sustained whooshing sound, then a low, resonant hum."}, {"id": "600", "observation": "A loud, high-pitched, sustained scream is followed by a brief silence and then a low, continuous hum."}, {"id": "615", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact and a deep, resonant musical chord are audible in the recording."}]
